description: envd runs a filesystem call as the user in `Authorization: Basic base64(<user>:)`; with no header it uses the template's default user. envd's spec does not model the header. E2B's SDK sends it on stat, listDir, makeDir, move and remove (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/filesystem/index.ts, `authenticationHeader(this.envdApi.version, opts?.user)`; the header is built in envd/rpc.ts). The member is the user name; EnvdProtocol's mapMemberHeader encodes it.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The Linux user to run the call as; else the `RunAsUser` layer's, else the template's default user.
